commands.name: update
commands.description: Bring a repo's managed Doti assets up to the running tool's bundled payload + report the before→after version. Source defaults to the bundled payload beside the executable (run from anywhere; fail-closed if unresolvable). Reconciles in a git worktree (--dry-run previews); git required; customizations preserved (--force to overwrite); orphaned rendered-skill dirs pruned; on a successful apply makes one sanctioned commit of exactly the touched paths (--no-commit opts out).

options.name: --repo
options.description: Target repository root. Required.

options.name: --agents
options.description: Comma-separated agents (codex,claude). [default: codex,claude]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite operator-modified managed assets instead of preserving them. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview the update in a worktree without applying it back. [default: False]

options.name: --no-commit
options.description: Leave the reconciled changes in the working tree instead of making the sanctioned auto-commit. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Force the machine-readable JSON envelope (auto-selected when output is piped). [default: False]

commands.name: update-all
commands.description: Batch-update every Doti-enabled repo under --root to the running tool's bundled payload (fail-soft), with per-repo before→after + a summary. Source defaults to the bundled payload beside the executable; each repo gets the same prune + sanctioned auto-commit behavior. --dry-run previews; --force overwrites customizations; --no-commit opts out of the auto-commit.

options.name: --root
options.description: Root directory to scan + update. Required.
